name: FABRIC_INTEGRATION_VERIFICATION
dynamic_binding: VERIFIED (GitHubFabricAdapter requires explicit binding or RuntimeConfig; fails with FABRIC_CONFIG_MISSING if unconfigured)
reachability: VERIFIED (Classifies SUCCESS, NOT_FOUND, AUTH_ERROR, NETWORK_ERROR, UNKNOWN; transport error is never CONNECTED)
node_identity: VERIFIED (Reads fabric/node.json, validates node_id, org, repo, purpose, status, and matches remote HEAD blob SHA)
tenant: VERIFIED (Reads fabric/tenants/{runtime_id}.json, enforces tenant_id match, raises TENANT_MISMATCH on mismatch)
admission: VERIFIED (Reads fabric/admissions/{runtime_id}.json or default_admission_policy; only ALLOW proceeds; DENY, PENDING, UNKNOWN, ERROR result in BLOCKED)
policy: VERIFIED (Reads fabric/policy.json, reconciles revision, require_admission, allow_local_models, allow_remote_models, max_workspace_size_mb)
contract: VERIFIED (Loads FabricContract with granted/revoked capabilities; revoked capabilities force Orchestrator.plan_task() to RoutingClass.BLOCKED)
remote_head: VERIFIED (node_json_exists_at_remote_head() verifies object at remote HEAD commit)
provenance: VERIFIED (validate_provenance() verifies commit existence, repository match, and remote state consistency)
fabric_read: VERIFIED (Full end-to-end chain Worker -> MCPGateway -> fabric.read -> fabric_client -> GitHubFabricAdapter -> Repository Fabric verified)
write_boundary: VERIFIED (fabric.register authorization denial verified; unverified positive write remains UNVERIFIED without live write permission)
